_baselineNote: CRK's default forecast anchors 2026/2027/2028 total production to its guided FY2026 total (1,250-1,400 MMcfe/d, mid 1,325, 'reaffirmed' this cycle -- already a daily rate, converted to this engine's internal Bcfe/d convention by /1000), held flat forward since CRK did not guide 2027/2028 production. CRK is predominantly natural gas and does not disclose a separate NGL stream, so nglMbblPerDay is fixed at 0 throughout; oil (an immaterial <0.03% of production) is split using CRK's own Q2 2026 reported oil share. CRK guides its cash cost structure component-by-component (LOE $0.27/Mcfe, gathering/transportation $0.37/Mcfe, production/other taxes $0.125/Mcfe converted to a %-of-revenue rate using CRK's own Q2 2026 commodity-sales-per-Mcfe, cash G&A $39mm total converted to $/Mcfe using guided production) plus a total FY2026 cash-interest figure ($230mm) and a derived cash-tax rate (effective 23% x (1 - 99% deferred) = 0.23%). CRK does not guide a gas or oil price/differential this cycle; both default to CRK's own Q2 2026 realized-price decomposition, held flat. CRK's guided FY2026 capital program ($1,450-1,550mm, mid $1,500mm, 'updated' this cycle) materially outspends its guided-cycle EBITDAX ($821mm), producing negative free cash flow and rising net debt across the forecast window -- a genuine guidance-driven output of CRK's disclosed growth-capital program, not a modeling error. The resulting default implied share price ($9.36) sits well below CRK's Q2 2026 quarter-end market price (~$14.92); this gap is disclosed as an accepted limitation (CRK's separately-guided Pinnacle Gas Services midstream segment EBITDA is not captured by this engine's commodity-only EBITDAX definition, and the model does not extrapolate production growth beyond the FY2026 guided rate into 2027/2028), not forced to reconcile to the market price.
